description: This file defines a singleton class VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync that manages synchronization of voice wake trigger settings between a gateway server and a local application state. It handles starting/stopping background tasks, fetching data from a gateway, subscribing to push notifications, and updating the app state based on received data.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for synchronizing voice wake trigger settings between the gateway server and the local application state. It manages background tasks, handles incoming push notifications, and updates the app's state accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the background task that periodically refreshes data from the gateway and subscribes to push notifications.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake trigger data from the gateway server and updates the app state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push notifications related to voice wake changes, decoding payloads, and updating the app state.
